connector.name: Ethora MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Ethora chat & messaging platform: chat ops, AI agents, RAG, automation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dappros account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ETHORA_API_URL
env.description: Full Ethora API URL. Defaults to https://api.chat.ethora.com/v1 if neither ETHORA_API_URL nor ETHORA_BASE_URL is set.

env.name: ETHORA_BASE_URL
env.description: Base host URL (e.g. https://api.chat.ethora.com). The server appends /v1 automatically. Use ETHORA_API_URL instead if you need a non-/v1 path.

env.name: ETHORA_APP_JWT
env.description: App JWT used for the user-auth bootstrap flow (login/register). Usually starts with 'JWT '. Optional; can also be set at runtime via the ethora-configure tool.

env.name: ETHORA_B2B_TOKEN
env.description: B2B server token used for tenant-actor x-custom-token auth (JWT with type=server). Required for B2B / app provisioning flows. Optional; can also be set at runtime.

env.name: ETHORA_MCP_ENABLE_DANGEROUS_TOOLS
env.description: Set to 'true' to expose destructive tools (app deletion, wallet transfers, bulk delete). Disabled by default.
